parameters.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.id AS app_id, j.title, j.company_name, coalesce(j.description,'') AS description, left(res.raw_text, 1500) AS resume_snippet FROM app.interactions i JOIN app.recruiters r ON r.id = i.recruiter_id JOIN app.outreach o ON o.recruiter_id = r.id JOIN app.applications a ON a.id = o.application_id JOIN app.jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id JOIN app.resumes res ON res.id = a.resume_id WHERE i.classification = 'interview_request' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.interview_prep p WHERE p.application_id = a.id) LIMIT 5;
